vr_weapon_adjustment_[0-9]+.description: Per-weapon model alignment loaded by the VR weapon renderer. The numeric suffix is a weapon ID in the selected game, not a portable name shared by JKA/JKO.
vr_weapon_adjustment_[0-9]+.values: Seven comma-separated numbers: scale, offset X, offset Y, offset Z, pitch, yaw, roll. Angles are degrees; offsets use the weapon calibration coordinate system, not headset metres.
vr_weapon_adjustment_[0-9]+.caution: Settings are cached by weapon loading; restart for a reliable comparison. Prefer shipped per-game calibration. Literal instances do not exhaust this dynamically named family.

r_vulkanVertexStyles.status: Implemented; JKA and JKO headset accepted
r_vulkanVertexStyles.description: Combines all authored vertex-lighting color layers on BSP surfaces with secondary light styles, including baked scenery models and patches. Uses the original integer RGB sum and clamp; preserves alpha, geometry and the single-style path. Updates affected GPU vertex ranges only when their light styles change, once per stereo frame, without additional draw passes.
r_vulkanVertexStyles.values: 0 restores the previous first-layer-only rendering for comparison; nonzero enables combined styles (default 1). Immediate, not archived, not cheat protected.
r_vulkanVertexStyles.caution: Not a global brightness or dynamic-light setting. Most surfaces have no secondary vertex lighting and will not change. Constant-color/emissive stages need not change either.

r_vulkanSpecularAlpha.status: Implemented; JKA and JKO headset accepted
r_vulkanSpecularAlpha.description: Evaluates authored alphaGen lightingSpecular highlights per vertex using each eye's viewpoint. World surfaces use the legacy fixed light origin; models use their local light-grid/dynamic-light direction. Does not add reflections or lights.
r_vulkanSpecularAlpha.values: 0 restores the former constant-alpha fallback for comparison; nonzero enables authored highlights (default 1). Immediate, not archived, not cheat protected.
r_vulkanSpecularAlpha.caution: Many affected stages are marked detail and require r_detailtextures 1 before starting the game. This is not a general brightness, bloom or armor-shadow control.

r_vulkanLocalFog.status: Implemented; geometry and vegetation headset accepted
r_vulkanLocalFog.description: Renders authored local BSP fog on assigned world surfaces, eligible generated vegetation and intersecting inline, MD3 and Ghoul2 models, clipping fog at the brush's exposed boundary plane. Separate from global distance fog and weather particles.
r_vulkanLocalFog.values: 0 disables local fog; nonzero enables it (default 1). Immediate, not archived, not cheat protected.
r_vulkanLocalFog.caution: Diagnostic comparison switch, not a water-opacity setting. Light amplification goggles override local fog. Does not add fog attenuation to independently submitted FX. Vegetation also requires r_vulkanVegetationFog.

r_vulkanVegetationFog.status: Implemented; headset accepted, including distance attenuation
r_vulkanVegetationFog.description: Applies the parent surface's authored local fog to eligible generated plants, including hanging vines, in their existing draw pass. Preserves leaf cutouts and distance coverage.
r_vulkanVegetationFog.values: 0 disables only vegetation local fog; nonzero enables it (default 1). Immediate, not archived, not cheat protected.
r_vulkanVegetationFog.caution: Requires r_vulkanLocalFog 1. Light amplification goggles override it. Does not add generic swamp haze, fog independent particles, change plant density or adjust water opacity.

r_vulkanRiftSeamDebug.description: Isolate the static rock3_phong wall material in JKA t3_rift while diagnosing bright vertical seams. This switch does not modify geometry; all modes share the load-time boundary correction. Has no effect on JKO or other maps/materials.
r_vulkanRiftSeamDebug.values: 0 normal rendering (default); 1 solid gray; 2 unlit base texture; 3 lightmap only; 4 hide the affected rock. Applies immediately, not archived and not cheat protected.
r_vulkanRiftSeamDebug.caution: Diagnostic modes suppress this rock material's finishing/fog/dynamic-light passes; other scene objects and effects remain. Mode 4 deliberately exposes the space behind the rock. Restore 0 after testing. This is not a seam fix.

r_flares.description: Light Flares in More Video. Generates halos for authored zero-vertex BSP flare records using their material, distance-sized quads and shared stereo camera axes.
r_flares.caution: Does not control saber bloom, dynamic lighting or ordinary FX sprites. Vulkan always depth-tests flare pixels, including with legacy value 2; it does not use blocking center-pixel readback or permit wall penetration. Static-world records only; inline flares are logged as unsupported.

r_vulkanDeforms.description: Evaluates authored wave, bulge and move material geometry deformations on the GPU in color, fog, light and shadow/depth passes.
r_vulkanDeforms.values: 0: disable this deformation batch; 1: enabled (default). Takes effect immediately; not archived.
r_vulkanDeforms.caution: Does not disable skeletal animation, scrolling textures, weather, grass wind, FX sprites or r_vulkanAutosprites. Collision geometry is unchanged.

r_vulkanAutosprites.description: Rotates authored static BSP autosprite quads toward the shared stereo camera and pivots autosprite2 strips around their fixed long axis.
r_vulkanAutosprites.values: 0: leave eligible quads in their authored orientation; 1: camera-facing (default). Immediate and not archived.
r_vulkanAutosprites.caution: Does not control grass, weather, FX sprites or BSP flare records. Restricted to affine, four-vertex static-world quads without mixed wave/bulge/move deformation. Unsupported surfaces are logged. Collision is unchanged.

cg_crosshairForceHint.description: Displays the original animated blue Force Push/Pull rings at eligible door/static-brush targets on the off-hand ray in VR. Uses the target depth, not a screen overlay.
cg_crosshairForceHint.caution: Requires the matching Force power and range. Independent of the ordinary Force cursor; hidden during cinematics, scopes, mounted aiming and weapon stabilization. A hint indicates Force eligibility, not a guarantee that a scripted action can currently complete.

vr_engage_trigger.description: Analog grip threshold at which the grip becomes logically pressed.
vr_engage_trigger.caution: This is the grip, not index trigger. Pair with a release threshold no higher than engage for sensible hysteresis.

vr_release_trigger.description: Analog grip threshold below which a previously engaged grip is released.
vr_release_trigger.caution: Not index-trigger release timing or grenade throw grace.

vr_motion_enable_saber.description: Allows the saber motion-attack path to be enabled even when the saber is not currently active.
vr_motion_enable_saber.caution: Not a universal motion-controller enable switch.

vr_comfort_vignette.description: Amount of the movement comfort vignette.
vr_comfort_vignette.values: 0 disables; positive values up to 1 are accepted by the drawing path.
vr_comfort_vignette.caution: Distinct from Force Sense peripheral darkening. Zoom/state handling affects when it is drawn.

vr_saber_3rdperson_mode.description: Camera preference while the saber is selected.
vr_saber_3rdperson_mode.values: 0: force first person; 1: allow toggling by pulling the turn stick back; 2: force third person.

vr_debug_movement_forward.description: Publishes the computed forward movement command for debugging. Runtime input overwrites it; not a normal movement control.

vr_debug_movement_sideways.description: Publishes the computed sideways movement command for debugging. Runtime input overwrites it; not a normal movement control.

cg_forceSpeedMotionBlur.description: Enables the Force Speed motion-blur effect exposed in More Video.
cg_forceSpeedMotionBlur.caution: Separate from the Force Speed FOV effect and r_vulkanForceSpeedBlurStrength.

cg_forceSpeedFOVAdjust.description: Enables the Force Speed perspective/FOV adjustment.
cg_forceSpeedFOVAdjust.caution: Does not enable the separate temporal motion blur.

vr_turn_mode.description: Selects stick turning, independently of head tracking.
vr_turn_mode.values: 0: snap; 1: snap in first person, smooth in third person; 2: smooth.

vr_turn_angle.description: Snap angle and legacy smooth-turn sensitivity parameter.
vr_turn_angle.values: Degrees per snap. Smooth maximum rate = value / 25 * 72 degrees/second, scaled by stick deflection.
vr_turn_angle.caution: Not directly degrees/second in smooth mode. Fixed guns use separate rates.

vr_mounted_yaw_speed.description: Maximum horizontal stick aiming rate on fixed guns; head look does not steer the weapon.

vr_mounted_pitch_speed.description: Maximum vertical stick aiming rate on fixed guns. Authored pitch stops still apply.

vr_thermal_throw_grace_ms.description: Retains a recent outward thermal-detonator stroke when release is late or the arm begins returning. Captures selected velocity at release.
vr_thermal_throw_grace_ms.caution: No auto-aim, guaranteed clearance, fuse change or minimum-speed boost. Headset tuning is pending.

vr_walkdirection.values: 0: off-hand orientation in first person; nonzero: head-relative reference.

vr_always_run.description: Uses normal running scale instead of selectable reduced walk-speed modes.
vr_always_run.caution: Analog stick movement remains proportional; this does not mean every small deflection is full speed.

vr_3rdperson_digital_direction.description: Enables legacy digital-direction third-person movement handling; also participates in movement-speed selection.

vr_switch_sticks.description: Swaps movement/turning stick roles; associated button mapping follows the control scheme.

vr_control_scheme.values: 0: right-handed default; 10: left-handed default; 99: weapon calibration.
vr_control_scheme.caution: Calibration is a developer workflow, not normal gameplay.

vr_positional_factor.description: Gain translating physical tracked movement into game movement commands.
vr_positional_factor.caution: Room-scale calibration, not stick sensitivity. Changes can affect collision behavior.

vr_irl_crouch_enabled.description: Enables physical crouch detection from tracked head height.

vr_irl_crouch_to_stand_ratio.description: Head-height fraction distinguishing physical crouch from standing.
vr_irl_crouch_to_stand_ratio.caution: Depends on standing-height calibration; seated play can differ.

vr_immersive_cinematics.description: Controls the immersive cinematic presentation request.
vr_immersive_cinematics.caution: Vulkan treats live cinematics, movies and security cameras separately; not a universal head-tracking switch.

vr_screen_dist.caution: The spatial debug console has independent fixed placement; this is not its distance control.

vr_refresh.description: Retained refresh-rate request; Linux VR_SetRefreshRate does not change the headset rate.
vr_refresh.caution: Choose refresh rate in WiVRn/the runtime instead.

vr_console_button.description: Long-press binding for the spatial console.
vr_console_button.values: 0: left Y; 1: right B; 2: off-hand Y/B according to handedness. Clamped integer 0..2.

vr_console_hold_ms.description: Hold duration before toggling the console. Short press retains its ordinary action.

vr_console_animation.description: Opening/closing expansion animation. Disabling gives immediate appearance, without moving the panel toward the player.

vr_haptic_intensity.caution: Individual effects clamp amplitude. Console confirmation uses separate direct feedback.

vr_saber_haptic_intensity.description: Additional intensity multiplier for sustained/brandishing saber haptics, separate from global intensity.

vr_gesture_triggered_use.description: Enables hand-reaching interaction with fixtures. Usable-target reservation arbitrates against Force Push.

vr_use_gesture_boundary.description: Hand extension boundary used for gesture activation.
vr_use_gesture_boundary.caution: Target availability and game rules still apply.

vr_force_motion_controlled.description: Enables gesture-triggered Force Push/Pull. With dual sabers, trigger alone immediately holds the selected power; hold offhand grip before pressing trigger to choose one push/pull gesture per trigger hold instead. Grip alone retains the force selector. Single-saber gestures remain unmodified.
vr_force_motion_controlled.caution: Dual mode is latched on trigger press: changing grip or moving the hand cannot switch a held selected power into a gesture. The chord cancels the selector without choosing a power. Offhand saber attacks are suppressed during either casting mode. Disabling retains ordinary trigger activation.

vr_force_motion_push.description: Force-power ID dispatched by an accepted outward gesture.
vr_force_motion_push.caution: Internal power ID, not strength or sensitivity.

vr_force_motion_pull.description: Force-power ID dispatched by an accepted inward gesture.
vr_force_motion_pull.caution: Internal power ID, not strength or sensitivity.

vr_force_velocity_trigger.description: Speed threshold for arming a Force gesture; history permits brief fast movements.
vr_force_velocity_trigger.caution: Displacement, palm direction, cooldown, Force energy and usable targets also matter.

vr_force_distance_trigger.description: Required radial displacement for an armed Force gesture.

vr_weapon_velocity_trigger.description: Motion threshold for velocity-triggered attacks. Saber speed includes a rotational contribution.
vr_weapon_velocity_trigger.caution: Not damage strength; some branches use half the threshold.

vr_scope_engage_distance.description: Near-head distance for engaging a supported stabilized weapon scope.
vr_scope_engage_distance.caution: Weapon type, stabilization and separate exit conditions still apply.

vr_virtual_stock.description: Enables virtual-stock aiming adjustment for stabilized weapons.

vr_weapon_pitchadjust.description: Pitch alignment offset for tracked weapons.
vr_weapon_pitchadjust.caution: Per-weapon calibration also applies; avoid compensating globally for one wrong model.

vr_saber_pitchadjust.description: Pitch alignment offset for the tracked saber.

vr_align_weapons.caution: Not a graphics quality option; can alter stored weapon transforms.

vr_vehicle_use_3rd_person.caution: The drivable AT-ST has its own elevated chase view; fixed guns are a separate path.

vr_vehicle_use_hmd_direction.description: HMD-direction handling in generic vehicle controls.
vr_vehicle_use_hmd_direction.caution: Does not replace dedicated fixed-gun stick aiming or legacy AT-ST controls.

vr_vehicle_use_controller_for_speed.description: Controller-based speed handling in the generic vehicle path.
vr_vehicle_use_controller_for_speed.caution: Vehicle type and its authored controls still matter.

vr_controller_debug.description: Detailed tracked-input logging, including mounted aiming and thermal release/spawn records.
vr_controller_debug.caution: Can generate large logs and add overhead; disable after testing.

vr_openxr_stick_dropout_guard.description: Controls compensation for abrupt attenuation of held stick input.
vr_openxr_stick_dropout_guard.caution: Keep the validated default; not a universal movement-speed fix.

vr_saber_block_debounce_time.description: Legacy debounce setting is registered, but no consumer was found in the scanned C++ sources.
vr_saber_block_debounce_time.caution: Do not assume this changes saber blocking; nominal value is milliseconds.

vr_engage_trigger_index.description: Legacy index-trigger engage threshold is registered, but no reader was found in scanned C++.
vr_engage_trigger_index.caution: Not established as an active Vulkan trigger sensitivity control.

vr_release_trigger_index.description: Legacy index-trigger release threshold is registered, but no reader was found in scanned C++.
vr_release_trigger_index.caution: Not established as an active Vulkan trigger sensitivity control.

r_vulkanBloom.description: Optional postprocessed bloom around emissive effects, including saber/scepter beams.
r_vulkanBloom.caution: Off preserves ordinary glow and dynamic lighting. This is the More Video bloom option, not an OpenGL switch.

r_vulkanBloomIntensity.caution: Requires r_vulkanBloom; high values can wash out detail.

r_vulkanBloomRadius.caution: Does not enlarge dynamic-light illumination on nearby surfaces.

r_vulkanGlowIntensity.description: Intensity scaling for ordinary emissive/glow effects, independent of optional bloom.

r_vulkanGlowRadius.description: Radius scaling for ordinary glow effects.
r_vulkanGlowRadius.caution: Not shadow softness or receiver illumination strength.

r_vulkanComputeSkinning.description: Compute skinning for supported animated GLM models, reducing CPU skinning work.
r_vulkanComputeSkinning.caution: Performance depends on scene and GPU workload.

r_vulkanModelDynamicLights.description: Enables dynamic-light receiver passes on supported models, including additional saber-lit objects.
r_vulkanModelDynamicLights.caution: Independent of bloom and character shadows.

r_vulkanModelCull.caution: Disabling can substantially increase work; use to diagnose missing models.

r_vulkanGLMLod.values: -1: automatic; nonnegative: requested LOD, limited by model data.
r_vulkanGLMLod.caution: Some models lack visibly different lower LODs.

r_vulkanGLMLodAudit.description: Logs animated-model LOD availability and selection.

r_vulkanEwebCull.description: E-Web model face-culling override for renderer investigations.
r_vulkanEwebCull.caution: Not a quality preset; retain the validated default to avoid missing/inverted faces.

r_vulkanVegetationDistanceScale.description: Extends procedural surface-sprite fade distances relative to authored values.
r_vulkanVegetationDistanceScale.caution: Higher distances increase work. Not tree-mesh LOD; improves the original short vegetation pop-in.

r_vulkanVegetationCoverage.description: Enables extended surface-sprite coverage handling added for Yavin.
r_vulkanVegetationCoverage.caution: Does not invent vegetation on materials that never requested it.

r_vulkanShadows.description: Enables the Vulkan shadow-map path alongside game-side shadow selection.
r_vulkanShadows.caution: Also requires cg_shadows >= 2. Saved settings/menu actions can differ from the registration default.

r_vulkanShadowFilter.values: 0: raw; 1: 5x5 PCF; >=2: soft 32-sample Poisson when available.
r_vulkanShadowFilter.caution: Pipeline availability can cause fallback; opacity is independent.

r_vulkanShadowOpacity.caution: More darkness does not improve geometric quality.

r_vulkanShadowWhiteArmorScale.description: Scales received shadows on recognized white armor without weakening cast ground shadows.
r_vulkanShadowWhiteArmorScale.caution: Not a global trooper brightness control.

r_vulkanShadowMapSize.caution: Higher values cost memory/GPU time. Restart to ensure resource recreation.

r_vulkanShadowCasterLimit.caution: Higher budgets cost more; not a guarantee every visible model casts a shadow.

r_vulkanShadowDepthBias.description: Constant raster bias when generating shadow maps.
r_vulkanShadowDepthBias.caution: Too little causes self-shadow artifacts; too much can detach shadows.

r_vulkanShadowSlopeBias.description: Slope-dependent raster bias for shadow-map generation.
r_vulkanShadowSlopeBias.caution: Not the decal offset factor; tune only with controlled shadow comparisons.

r_vulkanTiming.description: Renderer timing reports for command recording, waits and stereo GPU work.
r_vulkanTiming.caution: Not total headset latency or WiVRn encoding/decoding time.

r_vulkanMaterialAudit.description: Material/stage diagnostics for identifying surface rendering paths.

r_vulkanModelDynamicLightAudit.description: Logs model dynamic-light receiver behavior; does not itself enable a lighting effect.

r_vulkanFxModelAudit.description: Logs effect-model handling for missing/misclassified effects.

r_vulkanWorldDebug.caution: Nonzero modes intentionally alter materials/coverage, not quality presets.

rd_vulkanDiagnosticWorld.description: Diagnostic imagery used during renderer bring-up.
rd_vulkanDiagnosticWorld.caution: Do not enable while evaluating visual parity.

r_vulkanLegacyColorPipeline.description: Legacy-compatible color processing established during Quest comparisons.
r_vulkanLegacyColorPipeline.caution: Global behavior; not a local hologram fix.

r_vulkanQuestColorProfile.description: Whole-image color-profile comparison used for Quest/Wedge captures.
r_vulkanQuestColorProfile.values: Default 0. Mode 3 is an opt-in comparison, not a hologram-only default.
r_vulkanQuestColorProfile.caution: Latched and affects the overall palette.

r_vulkanLightmapGamma.caution: Broad lighting change, not a generic transparency correction.

r_vulkanForceSenseIntensity.caution: Vignette darkening has a separate control.

r_vulkanForceSenseVignetteStrength.description: Strength of binocularly aligned Force Sense peripheral darkening.

r_vulkanForceSenseRayScale.description: Spatial scaling of Force Sense rays.
r_vulkanForceSenseRayScale.caution: Not scene FOV or scope magnification.

r_vulkanForceSpeedBlurStrength.description: Temporal motion-blur strength during Force Speed.
r_vulkanForceSpeedBlurStrength.caution: Separate from the perspective/FOV pulse and the menu enable/disable switch.

r_vulkanWaterEffectIntensity.caution: Not universal water alpha; river, temple and wake paths are distinct.

r_vulkanWaterWakeIntensity.description: Intensity of walking/wake effects on water.

r_vulkanYavinWaterTransparency.description: Transparency tuning for the recognized Yavin temple-pool material.
r_vulkanYavinWaterTransparency.caution: Not the starting river. Retain the validated value unless testing this exact material.

r_vulkanYavinWaterDetailIntensity.description: Flowing detail/dot intensity on recognized temple water.

r_vulkanYavinRiverOpacityScale.description: Opacity scaling within the recognized river material path.
r_vulkanYavinRiverOpacityScale.caution: Cannot repair draw ordering or submerged geometry; those were separate bugs.

r_vulkanYavinRiverExtinction.description: Depth-related attenuation parameter for recognized river treatment.
r_vulkanYavinRiverExtinction.caution: Not generic fog or temple transparency.

r_vulkanYavinRiverLightmapGamma.description: Lightmap gamma scoped to recognized Yavin river treatment.

r_vulkanYavinRiverStageMask.description: Bit mask isolating river material stages.
r_vulkanYavinRiverStageMask.values: Default 15 enables the normal four-stage combination.
r_vulkanYavinRiverStageMask.caution: Other masks remove contributions; not visual presets.

r_vulkanYavinRiverDiagnostic.caution: Nonzero modes intentionally change its appearance.

r_offsetfactor.description: Slope-scaled depth bias for polygon-offset materials such as decals/panels.
r_offsetfactor.caution: Vulkan registration is not cheat-protected. Excessive bias can expose geometry; not a shadow-map bias.

r_offsetunits.values: Signed raster depth units, not metres/game units; accepted default -8.
r_offsetunits.caution: Vulkan registration is not cheat-protected. Use with r_offsetfactor for focused flicker tests.

r_picmip.description: Downsampling steps when loading eligible textures.
r_picmip.values: Larger integer values reduce texture resolution.
r_picmip.caution: Latched; restart for comparisons. UI/special images may bypass reduction.

r_detailtextures.caution: Latched; not universal sharpness. Detail stages can change rock/tree contrast.

r_lodscale.description: Scale for automatic model LOD selection.
r_lodscale.caution: Use with validated r_lodbias; not procedural grass fade distance.

r_lodbias.description: Bias for automatic model LOD selection.
r_lodbias.caution: Available LODs vary by asset. Not texture mip level.

cg_shadows.description: Game-side shadow selection, combined with r_vulkanShadows for Vulkan shadow maps.
cg_shadows.caution: OpenGL quality labels do not imply identical Vulkan algorithms; use More Video for consistent settings.

cg_worldScale.description: Conversion from tracking metres to game-world units.
cg_worldScale.caution: Affects perceived scale and physical placement, not just player height.

cg_heightAdjust.description: Vertical adjustment in tracked player/weapon placement.
cg_heightAdjust.caution: Not a fix for vehicle camera geometry.

cg_thirdPerson.caution: VR weapon/vehicle paths can override it; saved-game and runtime state matter.

cg_fov.caution: OpenXR supplies per-eye frusta. This does not replace physical headset FOV or repair stereo alignment.

cg_draw2D.description: Master control for ordinary game overlay/HUD drawing.
cg_draw2D.caution: Not the spatial console enable switch.

cg_drawStatus.description: Controls status HUD drawing, including health/armor information.

cg_drawFPS.caution: Not WiVRn transport or compositor timing.

cg_drawCrosshair.caution: Mounted guns and the AT-ST retain dedicated VR aiming markers when ordinary crosshairs are disabled.

cg_hudScale.caution: Not spatial-console font size; large changes can reduce VR comfort.

cg_hudStereo.description: Legacy HUD stereo/depth parameter consumed by Vulkan HUD projection.
cg_hudStereo.caution: Not IPD or physical eye separation.

cg_hudYOffset.caution: Separate from objective-message placement and the spatial debug console.

g_spskill.caution: Use New Game to select difficulty. Savegames/scripts can restore this value.

g_speed.caution: Cheat-protected; not a fix for analog dropout or collisions.

g_gravity.caution: Registered read-only and saved; maps/scripts control it.

g_dismemberment.caution: Game rules, target model and hit location apply; not full physical ragdolls.

g_corpseRemovalTime.caution: Other game/script cleanup can still remove entities.

developer.description: Enables developer messages in paths that consult it.
developer.caution: Can add substantial output; does not universally disable cheat protection.

timescale.caution: Changes gameplay timing, not only rendering; unsuitable for ordinary performance comparisons.

con_notifytime.description: Lifetime of transient console notification lines over gameplay.
con_notifytime.caution: Does not disable the full spatial console.

cl_inGameVideo.caution: Disabling can remove animated video content, not only standalone movies.
